name: suite-is-product-source
body: `opencode-suite/**` is product source: the tools and the shared lib are embedded into the `apg` binary via `include_str!` (`src/install.rs`, e.g. `apg_plan_phases.ts` at lines 120-123) and installed by `apg init` into `~/.opencode/`. This change-set authors the change in `opencode-suite/**`; the repo's own `.opencode/**` are consumer artifacts regenerated out-of-band from the installed release and are NEVER edited here. Satisfaction is assessed by review.
